ruleset.name: Apex Design Rules
ruleset.description: Custom rules for Apex design issues (structure, method signatures, class organization)

rule.name: UnusedVariableNotReturnedOrPassed
rule.message: Variable is assigned but never returned or passed to a method/constructor. Remove the variable or use it in a return statement or as an argument
rule.description:
Detects variables that are assigned but never returned or passed to a method or constructor. Variables should either be used in return statements or passed as arguments to methods or constructors. This helps identify dead code and unused variables that can be removed.
Version: 1.0.0
